  "schema_version": "formalization-faithfulness-1",
  "role": "blind-translation",
  "dossier_sha256": "7b93db3d2fcf72f5f6476a79f6aae2900c4f7646ed92b95f6ae6ea7f8b27116a",
  "dependency_coverage": [
    {"id":"D001","name":"LocalDef001","meaning":"A packaged solution for a specified law and two-state problem: a function q : R × R → R^m together with the initial-data and integral-conservation certificate described by D021 and D029.","effect_on_target":"Each existential solved(i) already carries both asserted solution properties and depends in its type on the chosen adjacent cell averages.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D002","name":"LocalDef002","meaning":"Projects the space-time solution function from a packaged solution.","effect_on_target":"The first real argument is space and the second is time; the target evaluates this function at time zero and applies integral conservation to it.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D003","name":"LocalDef003","meaning":"Constructs a problem from its left and right state vectors.","effect_on_target":"Constructs equal-state problems in the consistency assertion.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D004","name":"LocalDef004","meaning":"The interval has left < right, the field is interval integrable there, and the proposed average equals the interval integral multiplied by the reciprocal of its length.","effect_on_target":"Fixes each existential cell average uniquely to the normalized integral of initialState and includes positivity and integrability.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D005","name":"LocalDef005","meaning":"For q(x,t) and F, every spatial slice is integrable on every finite interval, every temporal flux trace F(q(x,t)) is integrable on every finite interval, and for all real a,b,s,t, integral_a^b q(x,t) dx - integral_a^b q(x,s) dx = integral_s^t [F(q(a,tau)) - F(q(b,tau))] d tau.","effect_on_target":"Requires exact rectangular integral conservation for every solved interface problem, at all real spatial endpoints and times.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D006","name":"LocalDef006","meaning":"A function equals the left state at every x < 0 and the right state at every x > 0, with no condition at zero.","effect_on_target":"Specifies the initial jump of each solution at local coordinate zero, with states from cells i-1 and i.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D007","name":"LocalDef007","meaning":"A grid with integer-indexed left and right endpoints, positive cell lengths, and adjacency, as specified by D024.","effect_on_target":"The grid binder already assumes positive widths and that the right endpoint of cell i-1 equals the left endpoint of cell i.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D008","name":"LocalDef008","meaning":"Projects the grid's left-endpoint function.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the lower endpoint of each cell integral and the endpoint used in adjacency.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D009","name":"LocalDef009","meaning":"Projects the grid's right-endpoint function.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the upper endpoint of each cell integral and the endpoint used in adjacency.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D010","name":"LocalDef010","meaning":"A law containing a flux, its everywhere Fréchet derivative, a matrix representation of that derivative, and real diagonalizability of every such matrix, as specified by D025.","effect_on_target":"The law binder carries substantial differentiability and spectral assumptions on all of R^m.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D011","name":"LocalDef011","meaning":"Projects the physical flux F : R^m → R^m.","effect_on_target":"Provides the flux in integral conservation and in the equal-state consistency equality.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D012","name":"LocalDef012","meaning":"A method containing a problem-domain predicate, a certified solver on that domain, an information extractor, a map from information to flux, inclusion of all equal-state problems, and consistency for the solver's equal-state outputs, as specified by D026.","effect_on_target":"Existence of certified solutions on the admitted domain and equal-state flux consistency are built into the method assumption.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D013","name":"LocalDef013","meaning":"Every equal-state problem belongs to the method's domain.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the domain proof needed to evaluate method.solve on every constant state in the consistency conclusion.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D014","name":"LocalDef014","meaning":"Projects the method's predicate specifying its domain of problems.","effect_on_target":"Restricts the initial adjacent-average problems in the hypothesis and the chosen-average problems in the conclusion.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D015","name":"LocalDef015","meaning":"Projects a function extracting an Information value from a certified solution, with the underlying problem supplied implicitly.","effect_on_target":"Determines information(i) from solved(i) and participates in equal-state consistency.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D016","name":"LocalDef016","meaning":"Projects the function mapping Information to a state-vector-valued numerical flux.","effect_on_target":"Determines numericalFlux(i) from information(i); imposes no additional formula for this map.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D017","name":"LocalDef017","meaning":"Projects the solver that accepts a problem and a proof of domain membership and returns a certified solution for that problem.","effect_on_target":"Appears explicitly for equal-state consistency; the existential solved family is not explicitly equated to its outputs.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D018","name":"LocalDef018","meaning":"For a sequence U and index i, constructs the two-state problem with left state U(i-1) and right state U(i).","effect_on_target":"Fixes the interface convention and the dependent types of the solved family.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D019","name":"LocalDef019","meaning":"Maps each cell index to the normalized integral of the given field between that cell's endpoints.","effect_on_target":"Defines the canonical averages used in the domain hypothesis before existential averages are introduced.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D020","name":"LocalDef020","meaning":"Returns U(i) - (timeStep / cellVolume(i)) times [edgeFlux(i+1) - edgeFlux(i)], using vector subtraction and scalar multiplication.","effect_on_target":"Completely specifies the existential updated averages by a single conservative flux-difference formula.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D021","name":"LocalDef021","meaning":"Packages a space-time function and a proof that it satisfies D029 for the specified law and problem.","effect_on_target":"Explains the mathematical content carried by every solved witness.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D022","name":"LocalDef022","meaning":"A law-indexed problem consisting of left and right state vectors, as specified by D003, D030, and D031.","effect_on_target":"Carries no additional state admissibility conditions; domain restrictions come from the method.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D023","name":"LocalDef023","meaning":"The volume of cell i is its right endpoint minus its left endpoint.","effect_on_target":"Identifies the denominator in the update as the positive cell length.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D024","name":"LocalDef024","meaning":"Constructs a grid from endpoint functions L,R : Z → R, proofs L(i) < R(i), and proofs R(i-1) = L(i) for every integer i.","effect_on_target":"Encodes positive, adjoining cells, without uniform spacing or unbounded spatial extent.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D025","name":"LocalDef025","meaning":"Constructs a law from F, continuous real-linear maps A(u), matrices J(u), proofs that DF(u)=A(u), proofs A(u)v=J(u)v for every u,v, and a real eigenbasis for J(u) at each u.","effect_on_target":"Restricts laws to everywhere differentiable fluxes with everywhere real-diagonalizable Jacobians; does not require distinct eigenvalues or continuous dependence of the derivative or eigenbasis.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D026","name":"LocalDef026","meaning":"Constructs a method from a domain D, a certified solver S on D, an extractor E, a flux map N, proofs D(u,u) for every state, and proofs N(E(S(u,u)))=F(u) for every state.","effect_on_target":"The conclusion's equal-state consistency and access to solutions on admitted problems are assumed through this structure.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D027","name":"LocalDef027","meaning":"The average on endpoints l,r is (r-l)^(-1) times the oriented interval integral of the field from l to r.","effect_on_target":"Defines both canonical and existential cell averages; the target's positive-width and integrability conditions make them actual normalized integrals.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D028","name":"LocalDef028","meaning":"There exist real numbers lambda(p) and a real basis b indexed by the matrix's finite index type such that J b(p) = lambda(p) b(p) for every p.","effect_on_target":"Requires a complete real eigenbasis for each flux Jacobian; repeated eigenvalues are allowed.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D029","name":"LocalDef029","meaning":"Conjunction of the two-state initial condition at time zero and D005 integral conservation for the law's physical flux.","effect_on_target":"Specifies exactly the certification carried by a solved object, without entropy or uniqueness requirements.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D030","name":"LocalDef030","meaning":"Projects a problem's left state.","effect_on_target":"The certified solution equals cellAverages(i-1) at time zero for negative local spatial coordinates.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D031","name":"LocalDef031","meaning":"Projects a problem's right state.","effect_on_target":"The certified solution equals cellAverages(i) at time zero for positive local spatial coordinates.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D032","name":"And","meaning":"Logical conjunction.","effect_on_target":"All listed properties must hold together for the same nested witnesses.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D033","name":"Eq","meaning":"Equality of two objects of the same type.","effect_on_target":"Requires exact endpoint, vector, information, and function-value equalities, not approximations or almost-everywhere equalities.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D034","name":"Exists","meaning":"Existential quantification over an object satisfying a predicate.","effect_on_target":"Introduces the successive averages, certified solutions, information, numerical flux, and updated averages.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D035","name":"Fin","meaning":"The finite type of natural indices less than its natural-number parameter.","effect_on_target":"Fin m indexes the m components of each state vector.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D036","name":"Fin.fintype","meaning":"The finite enumeration of all indices in Fin n.","effect_on_target":"Provides the finite component structure needed for vector norms, matrix sums, and bases.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D037","name":"HSub.hSub","meaning":"Projects the specified subtraction operation.","effect_on_target":"Expresses predecessor indices, endpoint differences, and vector differences using their respective subtraction instances.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D038","name":"InnerProductSpace.toNormedSpace","meaning":"Extracts the norm-compatible scalar-vector structure of an inner-product space.","effect_on_target":"Supplies real scalar multiplication and its norm compatibility for real components.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D039","name":"Int","meaning":"The integers.","effect_on_target":"Cells and interfaces range over every integer, with no boundary index.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D040","name":"Int.instSub","meaning":"Ordinary integer subtraction.","effect_on_target":"i-1 is the integer predecessor, without truncation.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D041","name":"IntervalIntegrable","meaning":"Integrability on (a,b] and on (b,a] with respect to the given measure.","effect_on_target":"Covers either endpoint ordering and ensures integrability on every interval requested by the assumptions and solution certificate.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D042","name":"LT.lt","meaning":"Projects the strict-order relation of the supplied instance.","effect_on_target":"Expresses positive dimension, positive time step, positive widths, and the strict half-line initial conditions.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D043","name":"MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume","meaning":"Projects the distinguished measure from a measure-space structure.","effect_on_target":"All interval integrals and integrability conditions use the distinguished real volume measure.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D044","name":"Nat","meaning":"The nonnegative integers.","effect_on_target":"The state dimension m is a natural number, further restricted by m > 0.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D045","name":"NonUnitalSeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedRing","meaning":"Forgets commutativity while retaining the seminormed ring operations without a designated unit.","effect_on_target":"Provides an intermediate inherited structure for the ordinary normed real-vector operations.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D046","name":"NonUnitalSeminormedRing.toSeminormedAddCommGroup","meaning":"Retains the norm, additive commutative group, and compatible pseudometric of a seminormed ring.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the additive norm structure of real components used in scalar-vector analysis.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D047","name":"NormedAddCommGroup.toNormedAddGroup","meaning":"Forgets additive commutativity while retaining the normed additive group.","effect_on_target":"Supports the norm structure used by interval integrability without adding a hypothesis.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D048","name":"NormedAddGroup.toENormedAddMonoid","meaning":"Gives a normed additive group its associated extended-nonnegative-valued norm and additive monoid structure.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the norm framework used to test integrability of vector-valued functions.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D049","name":"NormedCommRing.toSeminormedCommRing","meaning":"Retains ring operations and norm while viewing a normed commutative ring as seminormed.","effect_on_target":"Part of the inherited real scalar and component structures.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D050","name":"OfNat.ofNat","meaning":"Interprets a natural numeral in the specified type using its numeral instance.","effect_on_target":"Provides the natural zero, real zero, and integer one occurring in positivity and index formulas.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D051","name":"Pi.normedAddCommGroup","meaning":"The finite product normed additive commutative group with componentwise operations.","effect_on_target":"Makes Fin m → R the finite-dimensional normed vector space in which averages and integrals take values.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D052","name":"Pi.normedAddGroup","meaning":"The finite product normed additive group.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the vector norm structure in the explicit initial-state integrability hypothesis.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D053","name":"Pi.normedSpace","meaning":"The normed-space structure on a finite product, with pointwise scalar multiplication.","effect_on_target":"Makes normalized integrals and flux-difference updates real-vector operations.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D054","name":"Pi.topologicalSpace","meaning":"The product topology, generated by the coordinate projections.","effect_on_target":"Uses the ordinary finite-product topology on state vectors for integrability and differentiation.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D055","name":"PseudoMetricSpace.toUniformSpace","meaning":"Extracts the uniform structure associated with a pseudometric space.","effect_on_target":"Connects the real metric to the topology used on components.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D056","name":"RCLike.toInnerProductSpaceReal","meaning":"Views a real-or-complex-like scalar field as a real inner-product space using the real part of its scalar inner product.","effect_on_target":"Specialized to R, supplies its usual real inner-product and normed-space structure.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D057","name":"Real","meaning":"The real numbers.","effect_on_target":"Space, time, flux components, state components, endpoints, and eigenvalues are real.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D058","name":"Real.instLT","meaning":"The strict order on real numbers.","effect_on_target":"Positivity and half-line conditions are ordinary real inequalities.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D059","name":"Real.instRCLike","meaning":"The real numbers with their real-like field structure, identity real part, zero imaginary part, and usual norm and order.","effect_on_target":"Supplies real analysis instances; it does not enlarge states or eigenvalues to complex numbers.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D060","name":"Real.instZero","meaning":"The real additive zero.","effect_on_target":"Defines initial time, the local jump location, and positivity thresholds.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D061","name":"Real.measureSpace","meaning":"The standard measure-space instance on R, whose volume is Lebesgue measure.","effect_on_target":"The averaging and conservation integrals use real volume, not an independently chosen measure.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D062","name":"Real.normedAddCommGroup","meaning":"The ordinary real additive group with absolute-value norm and its metric.","effect_on_target":"Provides the component norm and vector-integration structures.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D063","name":"Real.normedCommRing","meaning":"The ordinary real commutative ring with its absolute-value norm.","effect_on_target":"Supplies norm-compatible real arithmetic throughout the definitions.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D064","name":"Real.normedField","meaning":"The usual real normed field, with totalized inversion satisfying inverse zero = zero.","effect_on_target":"Supports differentiation, scalar division, and normalization; the cell-width denominators are positive here.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D065","name":"Real.pseudoMetricSpace","meaning":"The real distance is |x-y|, with its associated metric structures.","effect_on_target":"Fixes the ordinary topology on the real variables and vector components.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D066","name":"SeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedCommRing","meaning":"Forgets the designated multiplicative unit while retaining the seminormed commutative ring operations.","effect_on_target":"An inherited-structure step for real component analysis, with no additional restriction.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D067","name":"UniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace","meaning":"Projects the topology of a uniform space.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the topology used in vector-valued integrability.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D068","name":"Zero.toOfNat0","meaning":"Interprets numeral zero as the zero of the given type.","effect_on_target":"Makes the explicit real zero literals the ordinary real zero.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D069","name":"instHSub","meaning":"Uses homogeneous subtraction as the corresponding heterogeneous subtraction operation.","effect_on_target":"Resolves subtraction notation without changing integer, real, or vector subtraction.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D070","name":"instLTNat","meaning":"The strict order on natural numbers.","effect_on_target":"The dimension hypothesis and its repeated conclusion mean m is strictly positive.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D071","name":"instOfNat","meaning":"Embeds a natural numeral into the integers.","effect_on_target":"The neighboring-cell offsets use integer one.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D072","name":"instOfNatNat","meaning":"Interprets a natural-number numeral as itself.","effect_on_target":"The lower bound in 0 < m is natural zero.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D073","name":"AddGroup.toSubNegMonoid","meaning":"Extracts subtraction and negation structure from an additive group.","effect_on_target":"Supports the ordinary difference operations in integral conservation.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D074","name":"Algebra.id","meaning":"A commutative semiring as an algebra over itself, with identity algebra map and multiplication as scalar action.","effect_on_target":"Real scalar multiplication on real components is ordinary multiplication.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D075","name":"Algebra.toSMul","meaning":"Projects the scalar action of an algebra.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the real scalar action used componentwise in vectors.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D076","name":"CommSemiring.toSemiring","meaning":"Forgets multiplication commutativity while retaining semiring operations.","effect_on_target":"Provides the scalar semiring structure required by algebra and module instances.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D077","name":"DivInvMonoid.toDiv","meaning":"Projects division from a multiplication-and-inversion structure.","effect_on_target":"Supplies real division in the time-step-to-width ratio.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D078","name":"Fintype","meaning":"A type equipped with a finite complete enumeration.","effect_on_target":"Ensures all component sums and component-indexed bases are finite.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D079","name":"Function.hasSMul","meaning":"Scalar multiplication on functions is pointwise.","effect_on_target":"A scalar multiplies every state-vector component separately.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D080","name":"HAdd.hAdd","meaning":"Projects the specified addition operation.","effect_on_target":"Forms the successor index i+1 used for the right interface flux.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D081","name":"HDiv.hDiv","meaning":"Projects the specified division operation.","effect_on_target":"Forms timeStep divided by cell length.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D082","name":"HSMul.hSMul","meaning":"Projects scalar multiplication.","effect_on_target":"Scales interval integrals, flux differences, and eigenvectors.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D083","name":"Int.instAdd","meaning":"Ordinary integer addition.","effect_on_target":"The right neighboring interface index is the integer i+1.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D084","name":"NormedAddCommGroup","meaning":"An additive commutative group equipped with a compatible norm and metric.","effect_on_target":"Provides the analytic setting for vector integration and subtraction.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D085","name":"NormedAddCommGroup.toSeminormedAddCommGroup","meaning":"Views a normed additive commutative group as seminormed using the same operations and norm.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the structure required by the real normed-space instances.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D086","name":"NormedAddGroup.toAddGroup","meaning":"Extracts the additive group from a normed additive group.","effect_on_target":"Provides subtraction and additive operations on integration values.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D087","name":"NormedSpace","meaning":"A scalar module over a normed field with norm-compatible scalar multiplication.","effect_on_target":"Makes state vectors a real normed space for integrals and Fréchet derivatives.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D088","name":"Pi.instSub","meaning":"Subtraction of functions is pointwise subtraction of their values.","effect_on_target":"The update and conservation equations hold componentwise as vector equalities.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D089","name":"Real.instCommSemiring","meaning":"The usual commutative semiring structure of the reals.","effect_on_target":"Supports scalar algebra and real multiplication without an additional assumption.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D090","name":"Real.instDivInvMonoid","meaning":"Real division is multiplication by the real inverse.","effect_on_target":"The update coefficient has the usual real quotient interpretation.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D091","name":"Real.instSub","meaning":"Real subtraction is addition of the additive inverse.","effect_on_target":"Endpoint lengths and component differences are ordinary real differences.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D092","name":"SeminormedAddCommGroup.toPseudoMetricSpace","meaning":"Projects the compatible pseudometric of a seminormed additive commutative group.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the topology used in the analytic state-space structures.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D093","name":"SubNegMonoid.toSub","meaning":"Projects subtraction from a subtraction-and-negation structure.","effect_on_target":"Supports vector-valued integral differences.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D094","name":"instHAdd","meaning":"Uses homogeneous addition as heterogeneous addition.","effect_on_target":"Resolves the addition notation in successor indices and arithmetic.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D095","name":"instHDiv","meaning":"Uses homogeneous division as heterogeneous division.","effect_on_target":"Resolves the ordinary real quotient in the update.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D096","name":"instHSMul","meaning":"Uses a scalar action as heterogeneous scalar multiplication.","effect_on_target":"Resolves vector scaling in averages, updates, and eigenvalue equations.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D097","name":"intervalIntegral","meaning":"The integral over (a,b] minus the integral over (b,a], using the given measure and vector-valued integration.","effect_on_target":"All interval integrals are oriented; the conservation identity allows arbitrary endpoint order.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D098","name":"AddMonoid.toAddZeroClass","meaning":"Retains addition, zero, and the zero identity laws of an additive monoid.","effect_on_target":"Supplies zero-related structure underlying vector integrals and module operations.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D099","name":"AddZero.toZero","meaning":"Projects the zero element from an addition-with-zero structure.","effect_on_target":"Supplies additive zero where required by the inherited algebraic structures.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D100","name":"AddZeroClass.toAddZero","meaning":"Retains addition and zero from a structure satisfying their identity laws.","effect_on_target":"An inherited-structure step for ordinary additive zero.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D101","name":"ContinuousLinearMap","meaning":"A continuous semilinear map for a specified scalar homomorphism; with the identity real homomorphism it is a continuous real-linear map.","effect_on_target":"The law's derivative at each state is a continuous linear operator on R^m.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D102","name":"ContinuousLinearMap.funLike","meaning":"Views a continuous linear map as its underlying function.","effect_on_target":"Allows applying the derivative at a state to a direction in the Jacobian representation equality.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D103","name":"DFunLike.coe","meaning":"Projects the function represented by a function-like object.","effect_on_target":"Interprets derivative evaluation and basis-vector evaluation as ordinary function application.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D104","name":"DenselyNormedField.toNontriviallyNormedField","meaning":"Extracts a nontrivial normed-field structure from a densely normed field.","effect_on_target":"Provides the real scalar-field requirements for Fréchet differentiation.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D105","name":"DistribMulAction.toDistribSMul","meaning":"Retains scalar multiplication and its preservation of zero and addition.","effect_on_target":"Supports the ordinary distributive real-vector scalar action.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D106","name":"DistribSMul.toSMulZeroClass","meaning":"Retains scalar multiplication and preservation of zero from a distributive scalar action.","effect_on_target":"An inherited scalar-action structure used by vector algebra.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D107","name":"ENormedAddCommMonoid.toESeminormedAddCommMonoid","meaning":"Views an extended-normed additive commutative monoid as extended-seminormed.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the extended norm infrastructure for integrability.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D108","name":"ESeminormedAddCommMonoid.toAddCommMonoid","meaning":"Retains the additive commutative monoid underlying an extended-seminormed structure.","effect_on_target":"Provides additive operations on values of integrable functions.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D109","name":"ESeminormedAddCommMonoid.toESeminormedAddMonoid","meaning":"Forgets additive commutativity while retaining the extended seminormed additive monoid.","effect_on_target":"An inherited-structure step in the integration framework.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D110","name":"ESeminormedAddMonoid.toAddMonoid","meaning":"Extracts the underlying additive monoid.","effect_on_target":"Supplies addition and zero for vector-valued integration.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D111","name":"HasFDerivAt","meaning":"The specified continuous linear map is the Fréchet derivative of the function at the specified point.","effect_on_target":"At every state u, F(u+h)-F(u)-A(u)h is o(||h||); this is a pointwise derivative condition, not continuity of u ↦ A(u).","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D112","name":"Inv.inv","meaning":"Projects multiplicative inversion.","effect_on_target":"Normalizes the integral by the inverse cell length.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D113","name":"Matrix","meaning":"A matrix is a function of a row index and a column index to its coefficient type.","effect_on_target":"Each Jacobian is an m by m real matrix.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D114","name":"Matrix.mulVec","meaning":"Matrix-vector multiplication, with component i equal to the finite sum of M(i,j)v(j) over j.","effect_on_target":"Defines the Jacobian action and its eigenvector equations.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D115","name":"Module.toDistribMulAction","meaning":"Extracts the distributive scalar action from a module.","effect_on_target":"Provides the ordinary real action on states and eigenvectors.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D116","name":"NonUnitalCommRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocCommRing","meaning":"Forgets associativity as a required structure field while retaining the same commutative ring operations without a unit.","effect_on_target":"Part of the real coefficient structure used for matrix-vector multiplication.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D117","name":"NonUnitalNonAssocCommRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocRing","meaning":"Forgets multiplication commutativity from the specified ring structure.","effect_on_target":"Supplies an intermediate algebraic instance for matrix arithmetic.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D118","name":"NonUnitalNonAssocRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocSemiring","meaning":"Retains addition, multiplication, distributivity, and zero multiplication while forgetting additive inverses.","effect_on_target":"Provides the finite-sum arithmetic needed by matrix-vector multiplication.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D119","name":"NonUnitalNormedCommRing.toNonUnitalCommRing","meaning":"Forgets the norm while retaining nonunital commutative ring operations.","effect_on_target":"Connects real normed arithmetic to the algebraic matrix operations.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D120","name":"NormedAddCommGroup.toENormedAddCommMonoid","meaning":"Gives a normed additive commutative group its associated extended normed additive commutative monoid structure.","effect_on_target":"Supplies norm-based integrability structure for state vectors.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D121","name":"NormedCommRing.toNonUnitalNormedCommRing","meaning":"Forgets the designated unit while retaining normed commutative ring operations.","effect_on_target":"An inherited-structure step for the real coefficients of Jacobians.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D122","name":"NormedSpace.toModule","meaning":"Extracts the scalar module underlying a normed space.","effect_on_target":"Supplies real linear algebra for derivatives and eigenbases.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D123","name":"Pi.Function.module","meaning":"The module structure on functions with pointwise addition and scalar multiplication.","effect_on_target":"States are real vectors whose algebra is componentwise.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D124","name":"Pi.addCommGroup","meaning":"The additive commutative group of functions with pointwise operations.","effect_on_target":"Provides the vector group used in differentiation and conservation differences.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D125","name":"Pi.addCommMonoid","meaning":"The additive commutative monoid of functions with pointwise addition and zero.","effect_on_target":"Provides the vector additive structure for bases, modules, and integration.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D126","name":"Real.denselyNormedField","meaning":"The real normed field with elements whose norms lie between any two appropriately ordered nonnegative bounds.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the nontrivial real norm structure required by differentiation.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D127","name":"Real.instAddCommGroup","meaning":"The ordinary additive commutative group of real numbers.","effect_on_target":"Provides componentwise real addition, negation, and subtraction on vectors.","status":"understood"},
    {"id":"D128","name":"Real.instAddCommMonoid","meaning":"The ordinary additive commutative monoid of real numbers.","effect_on_target":"Supports vector addition and finite matrix sums.","status":"understood"},
